Main dashboard UI is centered in these files:

1. **Key file paths + roles**
- `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/app/page.tsx`  
  Main dashboard page composition: layout shell, data fetch/save, sidebar, topbar, grid, map placeholder, secondary metrics, add-metric panel.
- `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/components/dashboard-grid.tsx`  
  Renders the metric card grid and card interactions (drag reorder, resize, remove).
- `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/components/metric-card.tsx`  
  Defines each metric card UI (label/value/trend + mini bar chart).
- `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/components/add-metric-panel.tsx`  
  “Add Metric” control panel for showing hidden cards.
- `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/lib/dashboard-data.ts`  
  Seed data/types for core and secondary metrics.
- `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/app/layout.tsx`  
  Root Next.js layout wrapper and global metadata.

2. **Where specific UI parts are defined**
- **Sidebar:** `app/page.tsx` (`SIDEBAR_NAV` + `<aside>` nav markup)
- **Topbar:** `app/page.tsx` (`<header>` with title, revision, timeframe buttons, region select, search button)
- **Cards:** `components/dashboard-grid.tsx` + `components/metric-card.tsx`
- **Map:** `app/page.tsx` (“Recent Jobs by Region” section; currently a styled placeholder, not a map library)
- **Metrics:**  
  - Core metric cards via API + `DashboardGrid` in `app/page.tsx`  
  - Secondary right-column metric tiles from `executiveSecondaryMetrics` in `lib/dashboard-data.ts`, rendered in `app/page.tsx`

3. **Design system / shared UI components used**
- No external component system (no shadcn/MUI/etc in deps).  
- Shared styling is Tailwind-based with custom tokens:
  - `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/tailwind.config.ts` (colors like `background`, `surface`, `neonTeal`, `accentOrange`)
  - `/Users/scottandersen/AI_accelerator/ai_projects/contractor-dashboard/app/globals.css` (global utility/token classes like `.bg-surface`, `.text-muted`, `.metric-card-surface`)
- Reusable shared UI components: `MetricCard`, `DashboardGrid`, `AddMetricPanel`.
